input.final_summary: Combat HUD styling is driven almost entirely by **`combat_test.gd`** at init and on resize; **`combat_root.gd`** only touches legacy/hidden labels and a power-intro fallback. content.text:
## Summary

Almost all combat HUD label/theme/alignment/stake overrides happen at runtime in **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test.gd`**, triggered from `_initialize_shared_layout()` and re-applied on resize via `_on_size_changed()` → `_apply_responsive_layout()`. Secondary touchpoints: **`combat_root.gd`** (legacy labels, power-intro fallback) and **`symbol_slot.gd`** (grid win-popup labels). Base theme is static in **`combat/ui/terminal_theme.tres`** and scene files, not applied by script.

---

## Primary: `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test.gd`

### Init / orchestration
| Symbol | Note |
|---|---|
| `_initialize_shared_layout()` | Entry point: reparents HUD, styles stake pill, wires resize handler. |
| `_organize_top_hud()` | Hides `TopBar`, reparents corner HUD, strips panel boxes, configures economics stack. |
| `_ensure_play_shell()` | Restores or builds play shell; downstream functions set winnings/stake layout. |
| `_finish_initial_layout()` | Deferred init: calls `_apply_responsive_layout()` then `_layout_combat()`. |

### Stake / economics HUD
| Symbol | Note |
|---|---|
| `_integrate_economics_into_center_hud()` | Creates `EconomicsCenter`/`EconomicsStack`; sets bankroll/stake `size_flags`, center alignment, reparents stake controls. |
| `_style_stake_pill()` | Wraps `BetLabel` in `StakePill` panel, sets pill stylebox, centers label, font size 22. |
| `_apply_economics_typography()` | On resize: overrides `BankrollLabel`/`GoalLabel`/`BetLabel` font sizes; sets bet ± button `custom_minimum_size`. |
| `_reset_container_child_layout()` | Resets stake/bankroll/etc. to `PRESET_TOP_LEFT` with zero offsets before reparenting. |
| `_refresh_readouts()` | Runtime text only (`bet_label.text`, `bankroll_label.text`, `goal_label.text`) — no theme changes. |
| `_on_bet_minus_pressed()` / `_on_bet_plus_pressed()` | Stake logic only; styling unchanged. |
| `_configure_hud_layers()` | Sets HUD `z_index` and `stake_selector.mouse_filter` — not typography. |

### Corner / goal / meta labels
| Symbol | Note |
|---|---|
| `_configure_top_corner_hud()` | Meta icon labels: `size_flags` + `font_size`; `GoalLabel`: right/center alignment + expand fill. |
| `_strip_corner_panel_boxes()` | Clears `MetaBox`/`GoalBox` panel styleboxes to transparent. |
| `_reparent_hud_to_root()` | Moves corner HUD to scene root (anchor rects applied later by `_place_control_rect`). |

### Winnings / multiplier readouts
| Symbol | Note |
|---|---|
| `_configure_winnings_readout()` | `MultiplierReadout`: font size, outline color/size theme overrides. |
| `_configure_cascade_multiplier_readout()` | Cascade label: font size, font/outline colors, outline size. |
| `_build_play_shell()` | When shell is built at runtime: sets winnings row alignment, label alignments, size flags, pill styleboxes. |
| `_finalize_play_shell_layout()` | Resets spin button `size_flags`/`custom_minimum_size` when restoring from scene. |
| `_pulse_cascade_multiplier()` | Tweens cascade pill `scale`/`modulate` — visual pulse, not font size. |

### Side panels / history (HUD-adjacent)
| Symbol | Note |
|---|---|
| `_style_side_panel_header()` | Side panel headers: center alignment, font size, font color. |
| `_make_side_panel_header_strip()` | Applies title strip stylebox + styled header label. |
| `_make_side_panel()` | Panel `size_flags`, stylebox, vbox separation, scroll/list size flags. |
| `_build_history_placeholder()` | Builds history panel via `_make_side_panel("HISTORY")`. |
| `_append_history_spin_row()` | Dynamically creates history row labels with size flags and `_apply_history_text_style()`. |
| `_apply_history_text_style()` | History labels: font size, colors, outline, shadow theme overrides. |
| `_build_item_picker()` | Item picker panel + checkbox/empty-label font size and color overrides. |

### Responsive layout / anchors
| Symbol | Note |
|---|---|
| `_on_size_changed()` | Resize hook: re-runs responsive layout and deferred grid layout. |
| `_apply_responsive_layout()` | Anchor-places `meta_box`, `goal_box`, `_economics_center`, `_play_area`; resizes side panels; calls `_apply_economics_typography()`. |
| `_place_control_rect()` | Sets anchor fractions and grow directions for HUD containers. |
| `_layout_execute_button_to_grid_width()` | Sets `spin_btn.custom_minimum_size` width to grid width + shrink-center flags. |

### Legacy suppression
| Symbol | Note |
|---|---|
| `_suppress_combat_root_legacy_labels()` | Hides `MultiplierLabel`, `RoundWinningsLabel`, `EncounterWonLabel` from combat root. |

---

## Secondary: `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd`

| Symbol | Note |
|---|---|
| `_ready()` | Applies outline theme overrides to `RoundWinningsLabel`; hides legacy multiplier/winnings labels. |
| `_ensure_power_intro_fallback_label()` | Creates power-intro label with anchors, font size 22, font/outline theme overrides. |
| `_layout_power_intro_fallback_label()` | Positions/sizes fallback label to match power intro icon. |
| `fit_to_panel()` | Grid layout only; hides legacy labels; sets slot `custom_minimum_size` (not HUD labels). |
| `_apply_slot_min_size()` | Sets grid slot cell `custom_minimum_size` at runtime. |
| `_refresh_multiplier_label()` / `_refresh_round_winnings_label()` | Text updates only for legacy (hidden) labels. |

---

## Grid overlay labels: `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\symbol_slot.gd`

| Symbol | Note |
|---|---|
| `_ensure_win_label()` | Creates win popup label: full-cell anchors, center alignment, font/theme overrides. |
| `_ensure_win_glow_label()` | Creates glow duplicate label with anchors, alignment, red glow theme overrides. |
| `_apply_win_popup_font()` | Applies shared win-popup font + `font_size` override to popup labels. |

---

## Other combat scripts (minimal / non-HUD)

| File | Symbol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\premium_meter_circle.gd` | `_ready()` | Sets meter `custom_minimum_size` (120×120); no label styling. |

No other files under `combat/scripts/` match label theme/font/alignment/stake override patterns.

---

## Static resources (editor baseline, not runtime scripts)

These define defaults that scripts may override:

| Path | Note |
|---|---|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\ui\terminal_theme.tres` | Root theme: Label 34px, Button 36px, SpinBox 32px, VT323 font. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn` | Scene overrides: `BankrollLabel` 36px, `BetLabel` 22px, `GoalLabel` 36px, stake button 40×40, economics stack alignment/separation. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scenes\combat_root.tscn` | Legacy label font sizes (18/20/42); theme assigned but labels hidden by `combat_test.gd`. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test_scaffold_baseline.tscn` | Baseline scaffold with same `terminal_theme.tres` assignment. |

---

## Key call chain for stake HUD overrides

```
_initialize_shared_layout()
  → _organize_top_hud() → _integrate_economics_into_center_hud() + _configure_top_corner_hud()
  → _style_stake_pill()
  → resized → _on_size_changed() → _apply_responsive_layout() → _apply_economics_typography()
```

If you're debugging stake label size drift, check **`_style_stake_pill()`** (sets 22px once) vs **`_apply_economics_typography()`** (re-applies 22/18px on every resize) vs scene defaults in **`combat_test.tscn`**.
